name: UWindsor CPC
description: The University of Windsor's competitive programming club. Get better at problem solving, prepare for technical interviews, compete in contests, and train for the ICPC East Central NA Regional.

home.headline: Learn algorithms. Compete. Go to ICPC.
home.pitch: UWindsor CPC is a student club for getting better at solving problems with code. Our weekly practice, workshops and contests build the skills behind technical interviews for co-op, internships and full-time jobs, and we train UWindsor teams for the ICPC East Central North America Regional, which UWindsor hosts.

highlights.title: Weekly practice
highlights.text: Practice nights and workshops on the core ideas: sorting, binary search, graphs, dynamic programming. Every session comes with problems to try on the spot.

highlights.title: Interview prep
highlights.text: Technical interviews for co-op, internships and new-grad roles are mostly algorithm problems. We work through the patterns that come up most: arrays, hashing, two pointers, trees, graphs and dynamic programming.

highlights.title: Club contests
highlights.text: A timed contest on Kattis every month, solo or in teams, with a live scoreboard. Every past contest stays open, so you can practise the problems you missed.

highlights.title: ICPC teams
highlights.text: We form teams of three and train them for the ICPC East Central NA Regional, which is hosted right here at UWindsor.
